post.description: Starts an asynchronous export for one or more objects from the selected backup and returns the job ID used to retrieve its status. For destination csv, the result is stored internally and can be downloaded when readyForDownload becomes true. For destination external-storage, storageId and path are required and the result is written directly to that storage. An object with no stored records can complete without generating a downloadable file. Object processing failures are reported asynchronously through the export status and public job logs.
